Action.description: No-code action executed when an event fires.

target.description: set/toggle: binding path; openPopup: id of a Popup or Modal node; setTab: id of a TabBar node.

value.description: set: literal or {"expr": ...}; setTab: Tab node id; copyClipboard: string (interpolated) or {"expr": ...}.

ActionType.description: set: assign value to target; toggle: flip a bool target; openPopup: ImGui::OpenPopup(target node id); closePopup: ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup; setTab: select tab value in TabBar target; copyClipboard: SetClipboardText(value); handler: call the generated handler.

Anchor.description: Anchor point of the Canvas rect the child is attached to; the same fraction of the child's explicit size is subtracted.

BindValue.description: Binding slot value: a binding path, or {"param": ...} inside a component definition.

BindingPath.description: Binding path root(.field|[index])* where root is a panel param name or state, e.g. player.health, cfg.esp.enabled, state.selectedTab, inv.items[2].name, items.size.

BoolProp.description: Bool prop; literal, expression or param reference.

ChildFlags.description: ImGuiChildFlags names without the prefix. Known names: Borders, AlwaysUseWindowPadding, ResizeX, ResizeY, AutoResizeX, AutoResizeY, AlwaysAutoResize, FrameStyle, NavFlattened. Other identifiers are accepted for newer ImGui versions.

ColorEditFlags.description: ImGuiColorEditFlags names without the prefix. Known names: NoAlpha, NoPicker, NoOptions, NoSmallPreview, NoInputs, NoTooltip, NoLabel, NoSidePreview, NoDragDrop, NoBorder, AlphaOpaque, AlphaNoBg, AlphaPreviewHalf, AlphaPreview, AlphaBar, HDR, DisplayRGB, DisplayHSV, DisplayHex, Uint8, Float, PickerHueBar, PickerHueWheel, InputRGB, InputHSV. Other identifiers are accepted for newer ImGui versions.

additionalProperties.description: ImGuiCol unknown to this schema (newer ImGui or legacy alias); still a #rrggbbaa color.

ColorProp.description: Color prop; #rrggbbaa literal, expression or param reference.

ComboFlags.description: ImGuiComboFlags names without the prefix. Known names: PopupAlignLeft, HeightSmall, HeightRegular, HeightLarge, HeightLargest, NoArrowButton, NoPreview, WidthFitPreview. Other identifiers are accepted for newer ImGui versions.

Ease.description: imb::Ease curve. Spring uses stiffness/damping instead of duration.

EnterSpec.description: Enter animation played when the node becomes visible (imb::BeginEnter).

stagger.description: Delay added per child index in seconds. Default 0.

EventSpec.description: Event binding: actions run in order, then the generated handler when handler is true. An event with neither is ignored.

actions.description: Actions executed when the event fires.

handler.description: Emit and call a handler function <Panel>_<id>_<Event>. Default false.

ExitSpec.description: Exit animation played when the node becomes hidden.

Expression.description: Expression: paths, literals, Enum::Member, arithmetic, comparisons, && || !.

Flags.description: Flag names without the ImGui*Flags_ prefix, e.g. ["NoResize", "NoCollapse"]. Names unknown to the running ImGui version are ignored by the interpreter and version-guarded by codegen.

FloatProp.description: Float prop; literal, expression or param reference.

FxSpec.description: One effect drawn around the item rect after it is submitted; parameters depend on type.

vertical.description: Top-to-bottom when true, left-to-right when false. Default true.

radius.description: Radius in px; omit for half of the item's larger side.

type.description: imb::Shadow: soft drop shadow behind the item.
imb::Glow: outer glow around the item.

connect.description: Draw lines between nearby particles. Default false.

connectDist.description: Maximum distance for connecting lines in px. Default 80.

type.description: imb::CursorHighlight: radial highlight following the mouse while hovered.

tint.description: Tint multiplied over the blurred result. Default #ffffffff.

type.description: imb::fx::Blur: shader background blur (needs shaderFx feature and a backend fx header).

InputTextFlags.description: ImGuiInputTextFlags names without the prefix. Known names: CharsDecimal, CharsHexadecimal, CharsScientific, CharsUppercase, CharsNoBlank, AllowTabInput, EnterReturnsTrue, EscapeClearsAll, CtrlEnterForNewLine, ReadOnly, Password, AlwaysOverwrite, AutoSelectAll, ParseEmptyRefVal, DisplayEmptyRefVal, NoHorizontalScroll, NoUndoRedo, ElideLeft, CallbackCompletion, CallbackHistory, CallbackAlways, CallbackCharFilter, CallbackResize, CallbackEdit. Other identifiers are accepted for newer ImGui versions.

IntProp.description: Int prop; literal, expression or param reference.

Layout.description: Placement inside a Canvas: cursor = anchor_point + offset * S - anchor_fraction * child_size.

offset.description: Offset from the anchor in px (DPI scaled).

Node.description: UI tree node. Only id and type are required; stock types are further constrained by stock-widgets.schema.json.

bind.description: Binding slots keyed by slot name; values are binding paths or {"param": ...}.

enabledIf.description: Bool expression; the node is disabled (BeginDisabled) when false.

events.description: Event name (onClick, onChange, onOpen, onClose, onEnter) -> EventSpec.

font.description: Name of a project font pushed around the node.

layout.description: Canvas placement; only meaningful for direct children of a Canvas.

locked.description: Emit this node as a locked block whose generated body the user may edit. Default false.

name.description: Display name shown in the hierarchy; not used in code.

props.description: Widget props keyed by prop name.

slots.description: Component instances only: slot name -> nodes inserted at the matching Slot.

tooltip.description: Tooltip shown while hovered; supports interpolation.

visibleIf.description: Bool expression; the node is skipped when false.

NodeId.description: Node id, unique within a panel or component tree; used for PushID, code markers and the live protocol.

NullableColorProp.description: Optional color prop; null means 'use the theme color'.

NullableFloatProp.description: Float prop where null means 'use the style default'.

ParamRef.description: Component parameter reference {"param": "name"}; only valid inside a component definition tree.

param.description: Name of a declared component param.

PropValue.description: Any prop value: a literal of the prop's type, {"expr": ...} or {"param": ...}. Stock widgets refine this per prop in stock-widgets.schema.json.

SelectableFlags.description: ImGuiSelectableFlags names without the prefix. Known names: NoAutoClosePopups, DontClosePopups, SpanAllColumns, AllowDoubleClick, Disabled, AllowOverlap, Highlight. Other identifiers are accepted for newer ImGui versions.

Size.description: Item size; both axes default to auto.

SizeListProp.description: List of SizeSpecs or param reference.

SizeSpec.description: Size of one axis: "auto" (0), a number (px, DPI scaled), "fill" (-FLT_MIN), "<n>%" of the available region, or "fill-<n>" (available minus n px).

SliderFlags.description: ImGuiSliderFlags names without the prefix. Known names: Logarithmic, NoRoundToFormat, NoInput, WrapAround, ClampOnInput, ClampZeroRange, NoSpeedTweaks, AlwaysClamp. Other identifiers are accepted for newer ImGui versions.

StringListProp.description: List of strings or param reference.

StringProp.description: String prop; literal, expression or param reference.

StyleOverride.description: Per-node style overrides pushed around the item.

classes.description: Names of project styleClasses applied before the local overrides.

additionalProperties.description: Style var unknown to this schema (newer ImGui); number or Vec2.

StyleVarMap.description: ImGuiStyleVar name -> number or {x,y} depending on the var.

TabBarFlags.description: ImGuiTabBarFlags names without the prefix. Known names: Reorderable, AutoSelectNewTabs, TabListPopupButton, NoCloseWithMiddleMouseButton, NoTabListScrollingButtons, NoTooltip, DrawSelectedOverline, FittingPolicyResizeDown, FittingPolicyScroll. Other identifiers are accepted for newer ImGui versions.

TabItemFlags.description: ImGuiTabItemFlags names without the prefix. Known names: UnsavedDocument, SetSelected, NoCloseWithMiddleMouseButton, NoPushId, NoTooltip, NoReorder, Leading, Trailing, NoAssumedClosure. Other identifiers are accepted for newer ImGui versions.

TableFlags.description: ImGuiTableFlags names without the prefix. Known names: Resizable, Reorderable, Hideable, Sortable, NoSavedSettings, ContextMenuInBody, RowBg, BordersInnerH, BordersOuterH, BordersInnerV, BordersOuterV, BordersH, BordersV, BordersInner, BordersOuter, Borders, NoBordersInBody, NoBordersInBodyUntilResize, SizingFixedFit, SizingFixedSame, SizingStretchProp, SizingStretchSame, NoHostExtendX, NoHostExtendY, NoKeepColumnsVisible, PreciseWidths, NoClip, PadOuterX, NoPadOuterX, NoPadInnerX, ScrollX, ScrollY, SortMulti, SortTristate, HighlightHoveredColumn. Other identifiers are accepted for newer ImGui versions.

Transition.description: Animated property change driven by an item state (imb::Transition).

to.description: Target value: number for alpha/offset/scale/rounding/border and float vars, #rrggbbaa for color.*, {x,y} for Vec2 vars.

TransitionProp.description: Animated property: alpha, offset.x, offset.y, scale, rounding, border, color.<ImGuiCol> or var.<ImGuiStyleVar>.

TransitionTrigger.description: Item state that drives the transition toward 'to': hover (IsItemHovered), active (IsItemActive), open (header/tree/popup open), visible (visibleIf result), focus (IsItemFocused), disabled (enabledIf false).

TreeNodeFlags.description: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags names without the prefix. Known names: Selected, Framed, AllowOverlap, NoTreePushOnOpen, NoAutoOpenOnLog, DefaultOpen, OpenOnDoubleClick, OpenOnArrow, Leaf, Bullet, FramePadding, SpanAvailWidth, SpanFullWidth, SpanLabelWidth, SpanAllColumns, LabelSpanAllColumns, NavLeftJumpsBackHere, CollapsingHeader. Other identifiers are accepted for newer ImGui versions.

Vec2Prop.description: Vec2 prop; {x,y} literal, expression or param reference.

WidgetType.description: Node type: a stock widget or a custom widget name from a .imw.json manifest.

WindowFlags.description: ImGuiWindowFlags names without the prefix. Known names: NoTitleBar, NoResize, NoMove, NoScrollbar, NoScrollWithMouse, NoCollapse, AlwaysAutoResize, NoBackground, NoSavedSettings, NoMouseInputs, MenuBar, HorizontalScrollbar, NoFocusOnAppearing, NoBringToFrontOnFocus, AlwaysVerticalScrollbar, AlwaysHorizontalScrollbar, NoNavInputs, NoNavFocus, UnsavedDocument, NoDocking, NoNav, NoDecoration, NoInputs. Other identifiers are accepted for newer ImGui versions.

description: Shared $defs for every ImForge file format: Node, SizeSpec, Color, Vec2, Vec4, PropValue, Action, EventSpec, StyleOverride, AnimSpec, FxSpec, Layout. Not a document schema by itself.
title: ImForge shared definitions
